# 1 Enoch Chapter 91 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** "Methuselah, my son — call your brothers to me, gather all your mother's sons. The word is summoning me and the spirit has been poured out over me. I must show you everything that is going to happen to you, right to the very end."

**2** So Methuselah went and gathered his brothers and all their relatives together.

**3** Enoch spoke to the whole assembled family — the children of righteousness: "Listen, sons of Enoch — hear every word your father speaks. This is my plea to you, my beloved children: love what is right, and live by it.

**4** Don't come to righteousness with a divided heart. Don't keep company with people who are double-minded. Walk in righteousness, my sons — it will lead you down good roads and travel with you every step of the way.

**5** I know this: violence will increase on the earth. A great reckoning will come down upon this world. All the unrighteousness that exists will be brought to an end — cut off at the root, its whole structure swept away.

**6** But wickedness will surge again on the earth, and every kind of iniquity, violence, and transgression will double in intensity.

**7** When sin, unrighteousness, blasphemy, and violent deeds reach their peak — when apostasy, corruption, and impurity flood the earth — then a catastrophic punishment will come down from heaven upon all of it. The holy Lord will march out in blazing wrath to judge the earth.

**8** In that day, violence will be ripped out by the root. Unrighteousness and deception together will be torn out from under the sky.

**9** Every idol the nations ever worshipped will be abandoned. Their temples will burn. They'll be cleared from the face of the earth, and the nations will never worship them again.

**10** The righteous person will rise up from sleep, and wisdom will rise with them — given as a gift.

**11** Then the roots of unrighteousness will be cut down. Sinners will be killed by the sword, eliminated from every corner of the earth — those who plotted violence, those who blasphemed — all of them will fall by the sword.

**12** After that comes the eighth week — the Week of Righteousness. A sword is placed in its hands to execute justice against all who have oppressed others, and sinners will be handed over to the righteous.

**13** By the end of that week, the righteous will have built homes for themselves, and a glorious temple will be built for the Great King — a house that will stand forever.

**14** Then in the ninth week, righteous judgment breaks open before the whole world. Every wicked deed vanishes from the earth. The world is slated for destruction, and all humanity turns toward the path of integrity.

**15** And in the tenth week, in its seventh part, the great eternal judgment arrives — and God executes his verdict even upon the angels.

**16** The first heaven disappears and passes away. A new heaven takes its place. Every power in the heavens blazes with sevenfold light.

**17** After that — countless ages without number, forever. Everything exists in goodness and righteousness. Sin will never be spoken of again."

---

*PNEUMA notes: This chapter opens the Epistle section and contains the tail end of the Apocalypse of Weeks (weeks 8–10). The fiery energy of vv. 7–11 anticipates the woe oracles of chs. 94–100. The new heaven of v. 16 is a striking early apocalyptic parallel to Isaiah 65:17 and Revelation 21:1.*
